tools.name: poliseo_list_insurance_products
tools.description: List the insurance products Poliseo compares, with the URL of each comparison page. Use this before navigating so the right page is chosen.

tools.name: poliseo_open_insurance_comparison
tools.description: Navigate this tab to the Poliseo comparison page for one insurance product. Does not fill in or submit any form.

tools.name: poliseo_read_current_page
tools.description: Read the main content of the page currently open on poliseo.pl as plain text, without the navigation and footer.
